queries.name: RACF - All Resources with No Auditing

queryList.query: MATCH (n) WHERE (n.auditing IS NULL OR n.auditing = 'NONE') AND (n:Resource OR n:Dataset) RETURN n ORDER BY n.class, n.name

queries.name: RACF - All Resources in Warning Mode

queryList.query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.warning = true RETURN n ORDER BY n.class, n.name

queries.name: RACF - All SURROGAT Relationships

queryList.query: MATCH (u)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource)-[t:TargetsUser]->(target:User) WHERE res.class = 'SURROGAT' RETURN u, r, res, t, target

queries.name: RACF - All UNIXPRIV Relationships

queryList.query: MATCH (u)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource)-[t:TargetsUser]->(target:User) WHERE res.class = 'UNIXPRIV' RETURN u, r, res, t, target

queries.name: RACF - All Group Memberships (Users)

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:MemberOf]->(g:Group) RETURN u, r, g

queries.name: RACF - Full Group Hierarchy (SubGroupOf)

queryList.query: MATCH (sg:Group)-[r:SubGroupOf]->(pg:Group) RETURN sg, r, pg

queries.name: RACF - All Group Relationships (Members + Subgroups)

queryList.query: MATCH (n)-[r:MemberOf|SubGroupOf]->(g:Group) RETURN n, r, g

queries.name: RACF - SURROGAT Chain (User -> Profile -> Target User)

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource)-[t:TargetsUser]->(target:User) WHERE res.class = 'SURROGAT' RETURN u, r, res, t, target

queries.name: RACF - Users with SURROGAT Access to Privileged Users

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource)-[t:TargetsUser]->(target:User) WHERE res.class = 'SURROGAT' AND (res.name CONTAINS 'ADMIN' OR res.name CONTAINS 'SYS' OR res.name CONTAINS 'IBMUSER') RETURN u, r, res, t, target

queries.name: RACF - Revoked Users

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.revoked = true RETURN u

queries.name: RACF - Users with SPECIAL Attribute

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.attributes CONTAINS 'SPECIAL' RETURN u

queries.name: RACF - Users with OPERATIONS Attribute

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.attributes CONTAINS 'OPERATIONS' RETURN u

queries.name: RACF - Users with AUDITOR Attribute

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.attributes CONTAINS 'AUDITOR' RETURN u

queries.name: RACF - All Highly Privileged Users (SPECIAL or OPERATIONS)

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.attributes CONTAINS 'SPECIAL' OR u.attributes CONTAINS 'OPERATIONS' RETURN u

queries.name: RACF - Users with No Group Membership

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE NOT (u)-[:MemberOf]->(:Group) RETURN u

queries.name: RACF - All Relationships for a Specific User

queryList.title: Select a User
queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.name
MATCH (u:User {name: $result})-[r]-(n) RETURN u, r, n

queries.name: RACF - All Members and Subgroups of a Specific Group

queryList.title: Select a Group
queryList.query: MATCH (g:Group) RETURN g.name ORDER BY g.name
MATCH (n)-[r:MemberOf|SubGroupOf]->(g:Group {name: $result}) RETURN n, r, g

queries.name: RACF - All DATASET Relationships

queryList.query: MATCH (u)-[r:HasDatasetAccess]->(d:Dataset) RETURN u, r, d

queries.name: RACF - Datasets with ALTER Access

queryList.query: MATCH (u)-[r:HasDatasetAccess]->(d:Dataset) WHERE r.access = 'ALTER' RETURN u, r, d

queries.name: RACF - Datasets with Public UACC (Not NONE)

queryList.query: MATCH (d:Dataset) WHERE d.uacc <> 'NONE' RETURN d ORDER BY d.uacc

queries.name: RACF - All Dataset Access for a Specific User

queryList.title: Select a User
queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.name
MATCH (u:User {name: $result})-[r:HasDatasetAccess]->(d:Dataset) RETURN u, r, d

queries.name: RACF - All Users with Access to a Specific Dataset

queryList.title: Select a Dataset
queryList.query: MATCH (d:Dataset) RETURN d.name ORDER BY d.name
MATCH (u)-[r:HasDatasetAccess]->(d:Dataset {name: $result}) RETURN u, r, d

queries.name: RACF - All SURROGAT and UNIXPRIV Access for a Specific User

queryList.title: Select a User
queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.name
MATCH (u:User {name: $result})-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource)-[t:TargetsUser]->(target:User) RETURN u, r, res, t, target

queries.name: RACF - All FACILITY Relationships

queryList.query: MATCH (u)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'FACILITY'}) RETURN u, r, res

queries.name: RACF - Users with BPX.SUPERUSER Access

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'FACILITY'}) WHERE res.name = 'BPX.SUPERUSER' RETURN u, r, res

queries.name: RACF - Users with Sensitive FACILITY Access

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'FACILITY'}) WHERE res.name IN ['BPX.SUPERUSER', 'BPX.DAEMON', 'IRR.PASSWORD.RESET', 'IRR.LISTUSER', 'RACF.SETROPTS.STATISTICS'] OR res.name STARTS WITH 'IRR.RADMIN' OR res.name STARTS WITH 'STGADMIN' OR res.name STARTS WITH 'MVSADMIN' RETURN u, r, res ORDER BY res.name

queries.name: RACF - FACILITY Profiles with Public UACC (Not NONE)

queryList.query: MATCH (res:Resource {class: 'FACILITY'}) WHERE res.uacc <> 'NONE' RETURN res ORDER BY res.uacc

queries.name: RACF - All FACILITY Access for a Specific User

queryList.title: Select a User
queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.name
MATCH (u:User {name: $result})-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'FACILITY'}) RETURN u, r, res

queries.name: RACF - All Users with Access to a Specific FACILITY Profile

queryList.title: Select a FACILITY Profile
queryList.query: MATCH (res:Resource {class: 'FACILITY'}) RETURN res.name ORDER BY res.name
MATCH (u:User)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'FACILITY', name: $result}) RETURN u, r, res

queries.name: RACF - All TCICSTRN Relationships

queryList.query: MATCH (u)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'TCICSTRN'}) RETURN u, r, res

queries.name: RACF - TCICSTRN Profiles with Public UACC (Not NONE)

queryList.query: MATCH (res:Resource {class: 'TCICSTRN'}) WHERE res.uacc <> 'NONE' RETURN res ORDER BY res.uacc

queries.name: RACF - All TCICSTRN Access for a Specific User

queryList.title: Select a User
queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.name
MATCH (u:User {name: $result})-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'TCICSTRN'}) RETURN u, r, res

queries.name: RACF - All Users with Access to a Specific TCICSTRN Profile

queryList.title: Select a TCICSTRN Profile
queryList.query: MATCH (res:Resource {class: 'TCICSTRN'}) RETURN res.name ORDER BY res.name
MATCH (u:User)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'TCICSTRN', name: $result}) RETURN u, r, res

queries.name: RACF - GCICSTRN Group Members (CICS Transaction Groups)

queryList.query: MATCH (g:Resource {class: 'GCICSTRN'})-[r:ContainsMember]->(t:Resource {class: 'TCICSTRN'}) RETURN g, r, t

queries.name: RACF - Users with Access to a GCICSTRN Group (and its member transactions)

queryList.query: MATCH (u:User)-[p:HasPermission]->(g:Resource {class: 'GCICSTRN'})-[c:ContainsMember]->(t:Resource {class: 'TCICSTRN'}) RETURN u, p, g, c, t

queries.name: RACF - All GCICSTRN Relationships

queryList.query: MATCH (u)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'GCICSTRN'}) RETURN u, r, res

queries.name: RACF - GCICSTRN Profiles with Public UACC (Not NONE)

queryList.query: MATCH (res:Resource {class: 'GCICSTRN'}) WHERE res.uacc <> 'NONE' RETURN res ORDER BY res.uacc

queries.name: RACF - All GCICSTRN Access for a Specific User

queryList.title: Select a User
queryList.query: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.name ORDER BY u.name
MATCH (u:User {name: $result})-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'GCICSTRN'}) RETURN u, r, res

queries.name: RACF - All Users with Access to a Specific GCICSTRN Profile

queryList.title: Select a GCICSTRN Profile
queryList.query: MATCH (res:Resource {class: 'GCICSTRN'}) RETURN res.name ORDER BY res.name
MATCH (u:User)-[r:HasPermission]->(res:Resource {class: 'GCICSTRN', name: $result}) RETURN u, r, res
